baseline.policy: Use the current broad-market price-floor, low-extension, high-volatility trend-persistence paper eligibility and score with its frozen universe, next-open clock, notional, costs and exits.

execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: At most one existing paper cash slot; positive-contribution ticker share below 40%; no portfolio allocation, production signal or order effect
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: Repository cash-equity commission and slippage assumptions at identical notional; no financing, borrow credit or option carry
execution_envelope.intended_instrument: TXG common stock for the current lead; any future cohort remains long common equity only, with no option, leverage, inverse product, proxy or short leg
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: Canonical OHLCV, next-regular-session-open availability, gap-cancel, stale-price and minimum-liquidity controls must pass
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: Filing acceptance, revenue-source fields, price inputs, universe membership and any independent utilization evidence must be known before each simulated decision open

candidate.falsifier: Reject or park if active-base and consumables definitions cannot be frozen as-known; if no vendor-resolved independent utilization proxy exists; if the event-to-price transmission is not identified; if any standard window has fewer than five executable treatment decisions; if D0-D3 finds a frozen near-neighbor; if one issuer contributes more than 40% of positive treatment value; or if H10 and H20 replacement value does not beat cash, SPY, QQQ and the unconditioned broad-market row after identical costs.
candidate.hypothesis: For a current broad-market price-leadership candidate in life-science tools, when the latest source-dated pre-decision filing shows positive year-over-year consumables revenue, a non-declining consumables share of product-and-services revenue and non-growing instrument revenue, the price move may reflect installed-base utilization rather than episodic equipment shipments; keep broad-market eligibility and score unchanged, use the operating condition only as a deterministic research admission tag, and evaluate the current TXG lead from the next regular-session open over fixed H10 and H20 replacement value.
candidate.replacement_value_comparator: Zero-return cash, identical-interval SPY and QQQ, and the exact unconditioned broad-market paper row at the same decision clock, notional, costs and exit policy.
candidate.title: TXG recurring-consumables pull-through continuation lead

treatment.policy: Keep broad-market eligibility and score unchanged. For life-science-tools observations only, attach a research admission tag when the latest source-dated filing known before the decision open reports positive year-over-year consumables revenue, a non-declining consumables share of product-and-services revenue and non-growing instrument revenue; otherwise abstain. Evaluate fixed H10 and H20 horizons.

candidate.why_not_arbitraged: The Q2 mix figures and the price reaction are public. A residual edge can exist only if investors underweight recurring utilization relative to volatile instrument shipments, and it must survive independent-evidence, PIT, touch-density, novelty, concentration and exact replacement-value tests rather than rely on the issuer narrative.

decision.rationale: All four roles agree that recurring consumables and service growth against falling instrument revenue form a coherent operating mechanism and that the Q2 filing preceded the current decision. They also agree that active-base utilization, independent evidence, canonical PIT, touch density, concentration, novelty, transmission, settled replacement value and portfolio opportunity cost remain exclusively for authoritative D0-D3 qualification, without override or trade authority.

researchability.basis: Current official filings establish a coherent recurring-consumables and service pull-through mechanism, and the latest Q2 filing was public before the 2026-08-07 decision. However, active installed-base utilization, independent vendor-resolved usage, canonical historical as-known disclosure vintages, cross-sectional comparability, treatment touch density and settled replacement values are not bound. The card is therefore lead-only and cannot establish admission or a trade.
limitations: Cumulative instruments sold includes systems that may be idle, retired, replaced or underused; TXG does not disclose active instruments or consumables per active instrument.
Several newer consumables do not require a 10x instrument, while pricing, product mix, distributor mix, channel inventory and platform transitions can change revenue without changing utilization.
The latest official financial observations provide one current issuer decision, not five executable treatment touches in every canonical window.
NIH awards express funding intent rather than actual assay runs and can fund competitor platforms, software or data reuse.
No canonical historical as-known filing corpus, vendor-resolved independent utilization series or comparable life-science-tools cohort is bound.
Derivatives, estimate revisions and Form 4 surfaces are not settled or gate-ready for the TXG decision.
Current live position control blocks additions and the current production signal set is empty, so cash/no-new-entry remains the executable opportunity-cost winner.

business_analyst.conclusion: TXG's operating model supports a real installed-base-to-recurring-consumables mechanism: consumables and service grew while instrument revenue contracted. This makes utilization quality economically more durable than episodic equipment shipments, but cumulative placements and issuer-reported usage do not prove active-base pull-through or H10/H20 persistence.

evidence.claim: TXG's Q2 2026 consumables revenue increased 7.0% year over year to $130.752 million and service revenue increased 26.0% to $10.681 million, while instrument revenue declined 47.2% to $7.661 million; the filing was accepted before the 2026-08-07 price decision.
The Q2 issuer release reported the same recurring-revenue pattern and was accepted by EDGAR at 2026-08-06T20:03:51Z, before the frozen decision date.

In Q1 2026, total consumables revenue increased 13% while total instrument revenue decreased 24%; Single Cell consumables reaction volume grew at a double-digit rate and Spatial consumables revenue increased 31%.

TXG states that instrument sales can lead likely future consumables sales and that recurring consumables revenue is expected to remain the bulk of revenue, while also warning that some consumables do not require a 10x instrument and that pricing and product mix affect usage and revenue.

business_analyst.uncertainty: Issuer disclosures do not identify active instruments, cohort churn, consumables per active system or a price-mix-channel bridge. The business mechanism is falsified if consumables and service cease growing for two comparable quarters while growth depends primarily on new instrument shipments, or if disclosed consumables per active instrument declines.

financial_analyst.conclusion: Recurring mix strengthened materially and balance-sheet liquidity is adequate, but the accounting bridge does not isolate utilization. Q2 consumables reached 87.7% of products-and-services revenue versus 84.2% a year earlier, while margin and cash-flow improvements contain tariff, warranty, inventory and settlement effects.

evidence.claim: Q2 consumables were 87.7% of products-and-services revenue versus 84.2% in the prior-year quarter, a 3.52 percentage-point increase, while instrument revenue fell 47.2%; these figures are computed from the issuer's filed revenue-by-source table.

Q2 gross margin improved 200 basis points to 74%, but the issuer also attributes the change to tariff refunds, lower inventory write-downs, lower warranty costs and product mix, so margin cannot be assigned solely to utilization.

At year-end 2025, cumulative instruments sold were 8,046, up 14.3% year over year, while 2025 service revenue increased 35% to $32.726 million as more instruments came off warranty; cumulative sales are not the same as an active installed base.

Cash and marketable securities reached $552.0 million and first-half operating cash flow was positive $43.1 million, but the cash-flow result benefited from collecting a litigation-settlement receivable and first-half net loss remained $31.4 million.

financial_analyst.uncertainty: The public data do not separate active-base utilization, price, consumable type, distributor mix, inventory timing or platform transition. The financial mechanism is falsified if consumables and service are both flat or down for two comparable quarters while cumulative instruments continue to grow, or if recurring-mix gains reverse after non-recurring items are removed.

industry_researcher.conclusion: Scientific demand for single-cell and spatial work is visible, and peer filings support an installed-base-to-consumables model, but no independent public series is both TXG-specific and timely enough to transmit causally to H10/H20 continuation. NIH awards are funding-intent records with procurement lags and competitor contamination.

evidence.claim: An FY2026 NIH award explicitly funds scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq and spatial transcriptomics, confirming scientific demand, but it identifies no vendor and therefore cannot be mapped to TXG consumables.
A high-intent NIH shared-instrument award serving 16 groups and 41 projects requested Vizgen's MERSCOPE, showing that raw single-cell or spatial award counts can accrue to a TXG competitor.

Illumina reported Q1 2026 consumables revenue growth of 4% and linked high-throughput demand to a growing NovaSeq X installed base; this supports the general pull-through mechanism but does not identify TXG utilization.

Bruker reported weaker academic and government analytical-instrument demand and combined Spatial Biology with Cellular Analysis, so industry capital demand is not uniformly strong even when assay use persists.

industry_researcher.uncertainty: NIH awards measure intent rather than actual runs and can fund software, data reuse or competitor platforms; peer filings are quarterly and aggregated. The no-proxy conclusion is falsified by a predeclared as-known vendor-resolved public series, such as TXG-specific reagent procurement or actual core-run counts, that leads consumables and H10/H20 continuation across at least five executable decisions per window.

risk_assessor.conclusion: The current event clock and recurring-mix mechanism are coherent enough to submit as a lead, but the frozen evidence contract is snapshot-only, the current replacement value is pending, no independent TXG utilization series is bound, all registered derivatives/revision/positioning lanes are unready, and portfolio controls block additions. D0-D3 must fail closed unless those contracts independently pass.

evidence.claim: The frozen outcome-blind snapshot ranks TXG first among the current broad-market paper rows but records replacement_value_pending=true, new_pending_entry=false and trade_enabled=false; it contains no return, PnL or Gate field.

The frozen surface registry labels the price and issuer roots snapshot_only with zero settled decisions; issuer roots have zero independent observations and the missing derivatives/revision context has zero candidate overlap.
The dynamic readiness artifact contains 13 registered lanes and zero ready lanes; no settled derivatives, estimate-revision, Form 4 or independent conflict cohort can be borrowed for this lead.

Current position control has ok_to_add_control_pass=false because immediate-exit, unconfirmed manual-bracket and stale-target conditions remain active; production and pilot signal arrays are empty, so cash/no-new-entry is the executable comparator.

risk_assessor.uncertainty: Historical filing clocks, active-base definitions, vendor resolution, touch density, concentration, factor exposure and portfolio covariance remain unresolved. A single-issuer positive result would breach the preregistered 40% contribution cap, and any replay using current mappings or revised disclosures without known_at enforcement would be not_pit.

subject.research_question: For the current rank-one TXG broad-market paper row, does source-dated installed-base utilization expressed through consumables and service pull-through identify a more durable next-open H10/H20 continuation candidate than unconditioned price leadership?
